name: custom-skills-plugin
description: Customized development workflows and engineering skills

slash_commands.name: workflow
slash_commands.instruction: Please invoke the dev-workflow skill and strictly follow the 9-stage implementation loop.

slash_commands.name: test
slash_commands.instruction: Please act as a test-engineer and follow the rules in the test-engineer.md agent.

slash_commands.name: review
slash_commands.instruction: Please invoke the code-review-and-quality skill to review the recent changes.

slash_commands.name: spec
slash_commands.description: Trigger the nexus-architect skill to plan
slash_commands.instruction: Please invoke the nexus-architect skill to create or refine a specification.

slash_commands.name: ship
slash_commands.description: Run the pre-launch checklist via parallel fan-out to specialist personas, then synthesize a go/no-go decision
slash_commands.instruction: Invoke the shipping-and-launch skill. `/ship` is a fan-out orchestrator. It runs three specialist personas in parallel against the current change: 1. code-reviewer 2. security-auditor 3. test-engineer. Please invoke them in parallel.

slash_commands.name: code-simplify
slash_commands.description: Simplify code for clarity and maintainability — reduce complexity without changing behavior
slash_commands.instruction: Invoke the code-simplification skill to simplify recently changed code (or the specified scope) while preserving exact behavior.
